atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE reusable transparent PNG mascot rigging atlas for a Spanish preschool animated web episode.
Primary request: Make one definitive original mascot named Rosi, a small childlike dinosaur, in a square image ideally 2048×2048. This is a production sprite parts sheet to assemble and animate ONE coherent character as a lightweight 2D puppet. NOT a character design exploration.
Subject: Original feature-animation-quality stylized 3D baby dinosaur with soft rose-pink/coral skin, cream tummy, rounded mauve back bumps, very large expressive teal eyes with amber inner rings, plump friendly proportions, short legs and tail, a small mint-green explorer backpack with a tiny golden star clasp. No scary claws or sharp teeth. No recognizable existing characters.
Style/medium: Warm polished stylized 3D, front-facing orthographic mild 3D view, smooth toy-like subtle skin texture. Every part shares identical soft warm upper-left lighting. No cast shadow and no ground.
Composition/framing: Four clear invisible quadrants with generous TRUE TRANSPARENT gaps between all parts. Parts MUST be cleanly separated and MUST NOT overlap. Upper-left: a single large rounded HEAD with snout, nostrils, cheeks, and mauve rounded back bumps where needed; OMIT BOTH EYES, EYEBROWS, AND MOUTH COMPLETELY, leaving blank face surfaces for separately composited features. The head uses most of its quadrant. Upper-right: a single BODY including neck, cream belly, mint backpack, legs and short tail, but OMIT HEAD AND BOTH ARMS. The body uses most of its quadrant. Lower-left: TWO SEPARATE short ARMS, each with a round shoulder joint at its top and a small relaxed three-finger paw below. Lower-right: FACIAL PARTS arranged in clean separate rows with generous space: first row a PAIR of large OPEN EYES with eyebrows; second row matching gently CLOSED EYES with eyebrows; third row TWO SMALL MOUTH SHAPES SIDE BY SIDE, one friendly OPEN TALKING MOUTH, one CLOSED SMILE. Each facial part floats independently on true transparency, NOT a rectangular skin patch. Keep all parts comfortably inside canvas boundaries.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine fully transparent background with a real PNG alpha channel. Everything outside character part silhouettes is alpha 0. Preserve smooth antialiased alpha at edges. This is NOT a white, gray, black, or checkerboard background image; do NOT draw checkerboard squares.
Constraints: ONE atlas only. One coherent original mascot, not multiple concepts, not full-body poses. No grid lines, no labels, no borders, no written text, no brands, no watermark. True alpha transparency is mandatory.
backdrop:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE reusable wide landscape backdrop for a Spanish preschool animated web episode; ideal size 1536×1024, or widescreen 16:9.
Primary request: A magical welcoming prehistoric valley in daylight, as a warm polished stylized 3D children's feature-animation environment. Background only, with clear stages for character and HTML overlays.
Scene/backdrop: Turquoise sky with very few soft white clouds. Lush fern fronds and cycads frame the far left and right edges. Distant rounded rose and mauve rocky hills and a very distant sleeping volcano with no lava and no smoke. A winding ochre path crosses a grassy clearing in the lower half. A little nest with exactly TWO cream speckled dinosaur eggs sits near the lower-right edge.
Composition/framing: Wide establishing landscape. The CENTER-LEFT FOREGROUND MUST be a large uncluttered clear stage for a separately animated large character: low grass, gentle path, no foreground rocks or tall plants there. The RIGHT-MIDDLE MUST have quiet negative space suitable for teaching cards and subtitles drawn by HTML, with simple soft distant scenery and no busy focal objects. Keep framing foliage at the outer edges; keep nest near lower-right edge outside the main right-middle teaching-card space.
Style/medium: High-quality warm stylized 3D animation environment, rounded friendly forms, rich mint and emerald foliage, peach sunlight, rose-gold accents, soft atmospheric depth and a welcoming preschool mood. Matching a rose-pink toy-like dinosaur mascot's warm upper-left lighting.
Constraints: Background environment only, NO dinosaurs, people, mascots or other characters. No text, logos, watermarks or borders. No lava, no smoke, nothing scary. One still backdrop, no animated video.
